message.content:
The user wants to turn WiFi on. I can see we're in the Network & internet settings page. I can see there's an "Internet" option at the top which shows "Networks available". This is likely where I need to go to access WiFi settings.

Looking at the current screen, I can see:
- Network & internet title
- Internet option with "Networks available" 
- Calls & SMS
- SIMs
- Airplane mode (with a toggle switch that appears to be off)
- Hotspot & tethering (Off)
- Data Saver (Off)
- VPN
- Mobile plan
- Private DNS

To turn WiFi on, I need to tap on the "Internet" option which should take me to the WiFi settings.
